newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro awards ABB NOK 170 mln Troll deal.
newsitem.headline: Hydro awards ABB NOK 170 mln Troll deal.

text.p: Norway's Norsk Hydro ASA, as operator of the Troll Oil development, said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent with ABB Offshore Technology AS for the delivery of a subsea unit for the separation and injection of water into production wells in the Troll Oil Gas province.
"The supply from ABB Offshore Technology AS will have a value of about 170 million crowns ($24 million)," Hydro said in a statement.
The unit will be installed on the sea bottom in the summer of 1999 in 340 meters of water.

The use of a subsea separation and injection system will reduce the fluid-processing capacity requirements and equipment-weight on platforms and will also reduce the discharge of produced water, giving environmental gains, Hydro said.
